Package clases

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    Activo
    The Asset class that represents the system, related to asset tracking, management of resources present in the library.
    Biblioteca
    The Library class represents the library that contains books and equipment.
    Computadora
    The Computer class is a type of library equipment, specifically a computer This class inherits from the Equipment class, which means it shares some common features with other types of equipment in the library
    Devolucion
    The return class is used to record returns of items (books or equipment) loaned to users.
    Ejemplar
    The "Ejemplar" class represents a type of book in the library
    Libro  
    Nota  
    Persona
    The person class is designed in order to identify the types of people, whether teacher or student, and has its variables that are inherited in both the teacher and student class.
    Prestamo
    The Loan class represents the loans in the system, related to the library.
    Tablet
    The tablet class is for the purpose of identifying the quantities of tablets available for the loan and their status.
    Usuario
    User is a public class that extends the Person class, which means that it inherits attributes and methods from the Person class
